title: Position request drafting
notes: Synthetic drafting scenario grounded in implemented position fields and AG2's implemented requisition actions; the position-specific salary/date correction and draft-confirmation composition is an advisory extension.
reviewQuestions: Can a manager understand salary and date fields and correct errors without losing other values?
Does the draft confirmation clearly show the saved fixture values and distinguish them from a real submission?
outcomes: A user can save a corrected position request as a draft with salary and timing context.
The resulting confirmation identifies the saved fixture request and supports returning to edit it.
